subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader branch be the canonical landing path for both the Tavily fallback bug and the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot bug?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but another proof-positive Tavily-only PR remains open; choosing whether to combine or split the agent-runtime portion is a maintainer ownership and merge-risk decision.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix

options.title: Split the agent runtime repair
options.body: Land the narrower Tavily resolver change and require the Tool Search runtime-snapshot helper and tests in a separate focused PR.

options.title: Use the Tavily-only PR

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Refresh and merge this PR as the single implementation for both root causes, then retire the narrower Tavily-only candidates.
